visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Every Multiple Says FizzBuzz
visualizerParams.problemDescription: 3 should print Fizz and 5 should print Buzz, but the program prints FizzBuzz for both.

solution.explanation: FizzBuzz is for numbers divisible by both 3 and 5, which needs &&. With || the first branch catches every number divisible by either one, so the Fizz and Buzz branches are never reached.

tests.pattern: (?<![\s\S])\s*1 2 Fizz 4 Buzz Fizz 7 8 Fizz Buzz 11 Fizz 13 14 FizzBuzz\s*(?![\s\S])
